integrity_statement: An original analytical specialization is stated with exact hypotheses, a full proof, explicit numerical verification scope, and attribution of general Fourier products and L2 criteria to their previous literature. There is no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the fair middle-third Cantor driver and matching contraction 1/3 are treated. Sobolev membership and nonmembership bounds are not asserted sharp. Continuity is undecided. Historical priority may depend on unindexed work.
title: An interval-supported but non-BV stationary density for a Cantor-driven random affine iteration
